disclaimer: Independent calculation and verification tool; not an official OPM service or payroll determination.
source_policy: Public data and comparison sources must be OPM or federal .gov sources only.

sources.title: OPM 2026 General Schedule base table
sources.note: Used for the official 2026 checkpoint fixture.

sources.title: OPM 2026 General Schedule locality pay tables
sources.note: Used for the locality area selector and 2026 locality percentages.

sources.title: OPM 2026 locality pay area definitions
sources.note: Used for county and FIPS locality-area mapping. Official OPM locality definitions control.

sources.title: Census 2025 National Counties Gazetteer
sources.note: Used for compact county representative latitude and longitude points; these are not boundary polygons or legal duty-station determinations.

sources.title: Census 2025 county cartographic boundary shapefile, 1:20,000,000
sources.note: Used for generalized county polygon geometry in the locality map; OPM locality definitions still control the pay-area assignment.

sources.title: OPM 2026 Rest of U.S. locality schedule
sources.note: Used for the 17.06 percent locality example.

sources.title: BLS CPI-U annual average data series CUUR0000SA0
sources.note: Used for the inflation comparison. 2026 is omitted until BLS publishes a complete annual average.

sources.title: Census 2025 State Government Tax Collections flat file
sources.note: Used only to flag states where Census item T40 Individual Income Taxes is coded X; this is not tax advice.

sources.title: BEA 2024 Regional Price Parities
sources.note: Used for price-level comparisons between BEA all-items RPP premiums and OPM locality percentages; this is not an OPM COLA determination.

sources.title: OPM pay administration fact sheets
sources.note: Used for divisor, hourly rounding, and biweekly calculation context.

sources.title: Federal Register 1979 GS schedule checkpoint
sources.note: Used for the 1979 nonuniform historical checkpoint represented in the source implementation.

sources.title: White House presidential information
sources.note: Used for presidential context in the historical context lab.

sources.title: National Archives presidential libraries
sources.note: Used as a federal presidential-history source for administration context.

sources.title: VA America's Wars
sources.note: Used for conflict-era context such as Desert Shield/Desert Storm and Global War on Terror.

sources.title: VA Dates and Names of Conflicts
sources.note: Used for operation date context including Iraq-era operation names.

sources.title: OPM Federal Workforce Data June 2026 employment raw data
sources.note: Used to aggregate visible Department of Veterans Affairs duty-station employee rows by location and all-agency locality cost pressure using annualized_adjusted_basic_pay, pay_plan_code, grade, and locality_pay_area fields. OPM notes the employment files are EHRI Status snapshots and some fields are redacted under the data release policy.

sources.title: OPM Federal Workforce Data duty-station standard
sources.note: Used for duty-station meaning, locality pay area fields, and the caution that duty-station reporting supports OPM workforce reporting and benefits/allowance administration.

sources.title: OPM General Schedule pay system overview
sources.note: Used for the rule that U.S. territories and possessions are in Rest of U.S. locality while GS employees in foreign areas are not eligible for locality pay.

sources.title: OPM 2026 nonforeign area COLA and locality rates
sources.note: Used for Puerto Rico, U.S. Virgin Islands, Guam/CNMI, other possessions, Alaska, and Hawaii locality/COLA context. COLA is shown separately from locality pay.

sources.title: VA Manila VA Clinic
sources.note: Used to identify the Manila VA Clinic as a VA facility in the Philippines. OPM FWD public employment rows do not expose a Manila/Pasay/Philippines VA duty-station count in the June 2026 release.

sources.title: VA Saint Croix VA Clinic
sources.note: Used to identify the Saint Croix VA Clinic location; employee counts are from OPM FWD duty-station rows, not from the VA facility page.

sources.title: Federal Reserve Z.1 Financial Accounts CSV package
sources.note: Used for the federal market proxy: household and nonprofit corporate equities from series LM153064105.Q. Dow Jones index data is not loaded under the federal-.gov-only source rule.
